Mega OTT setup guide

Set up Mega OTT on every screen.

Simple device-specific steps for your compatible player and your active Mega OTT credentials.

Choose your device

Installation guides for popular platforms.

Firestick & Android Box

Install an approved IPTV player, select M3U or Xtream Codes API and enter the details supplied after activation.

  1. Install your app player.
  2. Select “Xtream Codes API”.
  3. Enter server URL, username and password.

Samsung & LG Smart TV

Install IBO Player or Smart ONE IPTV from your TV store, then follow the player portal instructions.

  1. Open the app to note the MAC/ID.
  2. Add the playlist through the app portal.
  3. Restart the player after activation.

iOS & Apple TV

Install a compatible player from the App Store and create a new M3U or Xtream Codes connection.

  1. Install the player.
  2. Add a connection.
  3. Paste the active access details.

Windows & macOS

Install a compatible IPTV desktop player, sign in with the provided credentials and let the EPG synchronize.

  1. Install your player.
  2. Select the Xtream Codes login option.
  3. Wait for channels and VOD to load.

Answers, clearly

Setup questions answered.

Where do I get my Mega OTT login details?

Your credentials are supplied by support after the relevant plan is activated.

Should I use M3U or Xtream Codes API?

Use the format recommended by the player you install. Most popular IPTV players support Xtream Codes API.

What should I do if the EPG is not visible immediately?

Allow the player time to synchronize, then restart it if necessary. Contact support with your device and player name if the issue remains.
